The Compass

Everything hangs on this one picture. North up, East right — never sketch it tilted.

Turn Rules

Left = anticlockwise, Right = clockwise — always from the walker's current facing.

🌅 Shadow rules: at sunrise shadows fall to the West; at sunset they fall to the East. "A's shadow falls on B" → B is West (morning) or East (evening) of A.
📐 Distance: net East–West and North–South movement form a right triangle → displacement = √(x² + y²). Memorise triplets: 3-4-5, 6-8-10, 5-12-13, 8-15-17.
